content.comment_body: If your provider enables TLS, use port 587 and ensure you have a CA certificate. For SSL, select port 465. If you do not use a security protocol, opt for port 25.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exchanging requirements for setting up email (SMTP) communication on a [product_name] communication module. The main discussion covers selecting the correct port and protocol (TLS, SSL, or none) according to what the provider supports. Advice is given on port numbers and related certificate requirements, though setup may be more involved for those less familiar with these topics.
